verifications.claim: President Trump ousted Attorney General Pam Bondi on April 2, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'Trump fired Bondi on April 2'; R4: 'Thursday, April 2'; R1: 'announced Thursday'; R2: 'firing Thursday'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly confirm Trump ousted/fired Bondi on April 2, 2026.

verifications.claim: Pam Bondi's tenure as Attorney General was 14 months.
verifications.label: CLEAR

verifications.claim: President Trump's ouster of Attorney General Pam Bondi was driven by frustration over her handling of the Jeffrey Epstein files.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'frustrated with her handling... Epstein records'; R2: 'Epstein files'; R4: 'controversy... over the Epstein files'; R6: 'frustrated... including her handling of the Jeffrey Epstein files'; R7: 'frustrated with Bondi, in particular over her handling of the Epstein files'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources explicitly link the ouster to frustration over Epstein files handling.

verifications.claim: President Trump's ouster of Attorney General Pam Bondi was driven by a belief that she failed to aggressively prosecute political opponents.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'struggled to bring successful cases against Trump’s political enemies'; R2: 'fruitless retribution campaign'; R3: 'failed to lock up... political enemies'; R4: 'not pursuing more cases against his political opponents'; R6: 'not investigated or prosecuted enough of his political opponents'
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly attribute frustration and ouster to insufficient prosecution of opponents.

verifications.claim: Critics noted Pam Bondi failed to suppress documents revealing Trump's name.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R3: 'failure to make Epstein files disappear... Trump’s name appears in them many, many times'; R1: 'embarrassing allegations about the president'; R4: 'protect some of the powerful public figures whose names appear'
verifications.reasoning: Sources imply failure to prevent release of files mentioning Trump, but not precisely 'suppress documents revealing Trump's name' by critics.

verifications.claim: A senior ally described Pam Bondi's failure to suppress documents revealing Trump's name as a "whiff".
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R1/R2/R4: 'Susie Wiles said Bondi had “completely whiffed” on her handling of the [Epstein] files'; R3: 'failure to make Epstein files disappear... Trump’s name appears'
verifications.reasoning: 'Whiff' quote is directly supported for Epstein files handling, but specifically tied to suppressing Trump's name docs only vaguely via file contents.
